entities.name: Kesenya
entities.description: A tall, proud Kor veteran explorer and head of the Sea Gate Expeditionary House.

entities.name: Sea Gate Expeditionary House
entities.description: An expeditionary house founded with a secret benefactor's funds, led by Kesenya.

entities.name: Dragon's Frill
entities.description: A red-gemmed necklace from the Tazeem Skyclave offering fire protection and some control of flames.

entities.name: Tazeem Skyclave

entities.name: Iona
entities.description: An archangel who abandoned her guard post to fight the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker and secret benefactor of Sea Gate House who seeks the lithoform core.

entities.name: Zareth San
entities.description: Member of the party; his conversation raised Kesenya's doubts.

events.summary: Kesenya leads the first expedition into the Tazeem Skyclave and finds the Dragon's Frill.
events.quote: she found a collar-like necklace inlaid with opalescent red gems

events.summary: Nahiri funds the founding of the Sea Gate Expeditionary House.
Kesenya provides her best party for Nahiri's quest to the Murasa Skyclave.
After talking with Zareth San, Kesenya doubts Nahiri's quest and tells Jace the party's destination.
events.quote: Kesenya had some doubts about Nahiri's quest
